name: Configuration drift
short_description: Configuration drift is the gradual gap between the intended, documented state of infrastructure and its actual running state, typically caused by manual changes made outside infrastructure as code.

evidence.quote: Configuration drift now drives 97% of security incidents
The first symptom is configuration drift.
That is configuration drift. And it is the natural result of building environments by hand.
And also about the configuration drift, depending on how you set it up and how you configure it
